name: ambiguous-commit-lookup-then-insert-concurrent
description: The same reconciliation with a second delivery of the same request running concurrently (a client timeout re-sends while the first attempt is still in flight): the read does not establish that no other writer is about to insert, so the retry decision is unsafe even though it reads first.
